# Kuailu AI CRM | Core Use Cases

| Use Case | Need | How Kuailu AI CRM Supports It |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lead intake and assignment | Leads arrive from multiple sources and require prompt ownership. | Centralize supported lead sources, deduplicate records and assign follow-up responsibility. |
| Customer follow-up | Sales teams need consistent interaction records and next actions. | Capture activities, maintain account history and provide contextual AI assistance. |
| Pipeline management | Managers need visibility into opportunity stages, value and risks. | Use opportunity workflows, dashboards and reports to monitor the pipeline. |
| Sales planning | Representatives need to prioritize daily work. | Use customer and opportunity data to support task prioritization and next-step planning. |
| Order and collection coordination | Sales and finance teams need connected contract, order and payment information. | Link supported orders, collections and invoicing workflows. |
| Management analysis | Leaders need a consolidated view of sales execution. | Review dashboards, targets, performance indicators and drill-down reports. |
